liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1987-03-23.141287.5-1.tobin.flac1648** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 143 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd87-03-23.schoeps.weber-small.dnk.3870.sbefail.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 147 min; rated 4.55/5 by 22 [10]. Said about its sound: Listener describes the recording as amazing and one of their favorite audience captures; Recording features a fine wall of sound within the Hampton Coliseum venue; Listener highlights an awesome sonic boom from Jerry and Phil in the first thirty seconds [18][21][22][27]
- **gd1987-03-23.sbd.miller.95716.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 145 min; rated 2.4/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd1987-03-23.140683.UltraMatrixSBD.cm.miller.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 143 min [3]

## Around the show

- Audience erupted into loud cheering with high emotions during the performance of this song [18]
- Reviewer notes the band was tight and having a good time, matching the crowd's mood [19]
- Reviewer recalls skipping school to attend, feeling transported to a spaceship by the music [20]
- Jerry was in full hill-billy mode, ripping lyrics after Bobby's cowboy-energized previous songs [24]
- The opener rocked, with the show featuring crescendo after crescendo throughout [24]
- Crowd roar raised the version, though Jerry forgot whole stanzas during the performance [26]
- Jerry's voice dragged through the song, although his instrument performance was worthy [26]
- Booing occurred when someone lit an M-80 firecracker, prompting the crowd to keep it mellow [28]
- The performance is cited as standing out among the best of the 1980s [19]
- Reviewer states the show sounded better than the recently new CD format [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-03-23.141287.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: transferred by 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound Mix (48k) by Kevin Tobin; source: flac16/48kHz; 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound (48k) - SBD (shnid = 140679) Recording Info: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90); Transfer Info: Cassette… [1]. Also: Audio mixed by an archive.org user, converted to FLAC in March 2018 by Trader Little Helper [1]
- **gd87-03-23.schoeps.weber-small.dnk.3870.sbefail.shnf**: source: FOB Schoeps CMC44 > Oade P.S. > Sony PCMF1 [10]. Also: Recorded with Schoeps CMC44 into Oade P.S. and Sony PCMF1, transferred by Sean Weber-Small; DAT master copied to CD by Bill Gardner, with quality control by dankseeds [10]
- **gd1987-03-23.sbd.miller.95716.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette [2]
- **gd1987-03-23.140683.UltraMatrixSBD.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [3]
